dish.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
dish.description: Day-old rice stir-fried with chopped plant kimchi, kimchi brine, scallions, gochujang, and sesame oil. Vegan kimchi contracted; no egg, no bacon.

recipe_version.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipe_version.description: Day-old rice stir-fried with chopped plant kimchi, kimchi brine, scallions, gochujang, and sesame oil. Vegan kimchi contracted; no egg, no bacon.

ingredients.name: cooked rice
ingredients.note: cold, preferably refrigerated overnight. Fresh hot rice fries poorly. About 1 2/3 cups uncooked rice yield.
ingredients.preparation: cold, grains separated with wet fingers

ingredients.name: plant kimchi
ingredients.display_name: plant kimchi (no fish sauce, no shrimp)
ingredients.note: REQUIRED vegan/seafood-free contract. Buy kimchi labeled vegan/plant, or homemade without fish sauce, shrimp paste, oysters, or anchovy. Chopped. Reserve 3 tbsp brine from the jar. Do not use seafood kimchi.

ingredients.name: kimchi brine
ingredients.note: from the same vegan kimchi jar. Part of the seafood-free contract.

ingredients.name: gochujang
ingredients.note: store-bought paste. Typical commercial gochujang contains soy and wheat. Do not add a seafood-based stew concentrate.

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: regular soy sauce. Soy and wheat allergens.

ingredients.name: toasted sesame oil
ingredients.note: 1 tsp in the cook, 1 tsp to finish. Sesame allergen.

ingredients.name: scallions
ingredients.note: whites for the pan, greens for finish
ingredients.preparation: thinly sliced, whites and greens separated

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: only if needed after tasting soy and kimchi

steps.title: Prep kimchi and rice
steps.body: Confirm the kimchi label is plant/vegan with no fish sauce, shrimp paste, oysters, or anchovy. Roughly chop 2 cups kimchi; reserve 3 tbsp brine. Dice the onion. Mince the garlic. Slice scallions, keeping whites and greens separate. Break cold day-old rice into separate grains with wet fingers. Measure gochujang, soy sauce, toasted sesame oil, neutral oil, sugar, and sesame seeds. HARD CONTRACT: no egg, no bacon, no spam, no seafood kimchi.

steps.title: Sauté aromatics and kimchi
steps.body: Heat the neutral oil and 1 tsp toasted sesame oil in a 12-inch skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add onion and scallion whites. Cook, stirring, until onion softens, about 2 to 3 minutes. Add garlic; cook 30 seconds. Add chopped plant kimchi. Cook until edges look slightly jammy and the pan smells sharp and spicy, about 3 to 4 minutes. Stir in gochujang, kimchi brine, soy sauce, and sugar until the paste loosens into the kimchi.

steps.title: Fry the rice
steps.body: Add the cold rice. Press and fold to coat every grain in the red kimchi mixture. Spread into a thin layer. Let sit undisturbed 1 to 2 minutes so grains toast, then fold again. Repeat until rice is hot, stained red, and lightly toasted in spots, about 5 to 7 minutes total. Do not scramble an egg into the pan. Do not add bacon.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.body: Off heat, stir in the remaining 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and most of the scallion greens. Taste; add optional salt only if soy and kimchi have not already seasoned it. Serve in bowls. Scatter sesame seeds and remaining scallion greens. No fried egg on top. No bacon bits. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.heat: Medium-high skillet or wok throughout. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Rice hot, red from kimchi, lightly toasted in spots. Kimchi jammy at edges. No raw onion crunch left in the base. kitchen_tested is false.

dietary_eligibility.nut_policy_note: No peanuts, tree nuts, or cashews. Sesame oil and seeds are sesame allergen tokens, not tree nuts.
dietary_eligibility.hh001_reason: Plant kimchi fried rice. No dairy, no shellfish, no meat, no poultry, no egg, no bacon. Plant kimchi is contracted seafood-free. Soy, sesame, and wheat are present as allergens but HH001 allows soy/sesame/wheat. Nuts absent.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: Unconditional dairy_free, vegetarian, and plant_based. Plant kimchi must stay seafood-free; that is a hard shopping contract. No egg, no bacon, no milk, no meat, no poultry, no finfish, no shellfish.
allergen_notes: Soy covers gochujang and soy sauce (and may be present in some kimchi seasonings).
Sesame covers toasted sesame oil and sesame seeds.

Wheat covers regular soy sauce and typical commercial gochujang. If a cook substitutes certified gluten-free tamari and wheat-free gochujang, that is a different package; this written package lists wheat.
No egg, milk, peanut, tree_nut, shellfish, or finfish. Vegan kimchi contract excludes fish sauce and shrimp. No egg garnish; no bacon.
recipe_version.hh001_reason: Plant kimchi fried rice. No dairy, no shellfish, no meat, no poultry, no egg, no bacon. Plant kimchi is contracted seafood-free. Soy, sesame, and wheat are present as allergens but HH001 allows soy/sesame/wheat. Nuts absent.
